response.rationale: A and B both rest on DropTextClient (node 0e0ffaf33c6872c8, infrastructure layer, persistence component). A is narrower: in community:1, IceMonitorService (node f59a45a01c2ed338, domain layer, fan-out 10) works with IceStateRepository and uses DropTextClient to text customers about session holds caused by ice conditions. B is the general text-message channel found in component:persistence, a technical grouping of eight data and client classes. DropTextClient has fan-in 2, so another caller besides IceMonitorService may use texting for something else. That would make B a broader capability that includes A. If session holds turn out to be the only thing ever texted, the two would effectively be the same; the code shown is not enough to tell.
